Product

additional_info.subject: ID0379844-DC/Si-D/BE[170001563] - Failsafe mode CRM:00315001785
additional_info.body:
Hi Marnic,
Lorenz opened this ticket but he is on vacation.
The failsafemode is on because of the PLC being in Maintenance mode, I believe someone must've switch the hardware switch in the PLC.
Please check this otherwise I will look into it remotely.
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0379844-DC/Si-D/BE[170001563] - Failsafe mode CRM:00315001785
additional_info.body:
Francisco
But if the switch is put on hold then it wouldn’t reboot also I think.
Br.

additional_info.subject: ID0379844-DC/Si-D/BE[170001563] - Failsafe mode CRM:00315001785
additional_info.body:
Hi Marnic, good morning.
I didn't understand your statement. But if I understood, it doesn't matter even if the PLC is in stop mode, the charger is able to start up and reach failsafemode.
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0379844-DC/Si-D/BE[170001563] - Failsafe mode CRM:00315001785
additional_info.body:
Ok, I will plan an intervention on site tomorrow to see the status of the switch.
Br.

additional_info.subject: ID0379844-DC/Si-D/BE[170001563] - Failsafe mode CRM:00315001785
additional_info.body:
Hi Marnic,
After you visited the site today you found that Router 1 was not working and not reachable via direct connection.
Even after a reset the router still didn't come back to live.
I recommend you to replace the router with a new one.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
